classification: fingerprint instrumentation defect; scientific replication passes
cause: Arm payload fingerprints used FNV-1a over raw JavaScript floating-point prediction arrays. The batch hashes inherited those runtime-specific raw fingerprints. The world fingerprint itself correctly used twelve-decimal canonical rounding.
adjudicationMethod: Remove only raw arm payload fingerprints and their derivative batch hashes, remove execution-role metadata, then round every finite number to twelve decimals and canonicalize object keys.
prospectiveCorrection: Future arm payload digests must hash twelve-decimal canonical prediction arrays. Frozen v1.7 source and raw outputs remain unchanged.
architectureBoundary: The negative advancement verdict rejects these fixed structural-meaning encodings and thresholds under this field. It does not eliminate Gamma, contextual meaning, stored meaning, reconstructed meaning, or dual-process architectures as classes.
